definitions.explanation: The creation of decorative or functional objects by hand, often using traditional techniques.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{伝統|でんとう}{工芸|こうげい}に{興味|きょうみ}がある。
examples.english: I'm interested in traditional Japanese crafts.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}は{陶芸|とうげい}や{木工芸|もっこうげい}で{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: This area is famous for pottery and woodcraft.

examples.japanese: {工芸品|こうげいひん}を{作|つく}る{職人|しょくにん}が{減|へ}っている。
examples.english: The number of craftspeople making handicrafts is decreasing.

notes:
COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{伝統|でんとう}{工芸|こうげい} (traditional crafts)
・{民芸|みんげい}{工芸|こうげい} (folk crafts)
・{工芸品|こうげいひん} (handicraft item, craft product)
・{工芸家|こうげいか} (craftsperson, artisan)
・{美術|びじゅつ}{工芸|こうげい} (arts and crafts)

RELATED WORDS:
・{陶芸|とうげい} - ceramic art, pottery
・{木工|もっこう} - woodworking
・{染織|せんしょく} - dyeing and weaving
・{漆芸|しつげい} - lacquerware art

[Register: Neutral to Formal]
